# [TASK] Scaffold Vite config and move index.html to repo root

## Task
Install `vite` + `@vitejs/plugin-react`, remove `react-scripts`, move `public/index.html` to `frontend/filmpire/index.html`, update script tags to use `/src/index.jsx` as entry, and update `package.json` scripts (`dev`/`build`/`preview` replacing `start`/`build`/`eject`).

## Scope
Toolchain swap only. `REACT_APP_` → `VITE_` env var renaming is #126. Jest → Vitest is #127 — `npm test` (still `react-scripts test`) is intentionally non-functional until then, since `react-scripts` is now fully removed.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `vite.config.js` exists with `@vitejs/plugin-react` and correct aliases.
- [x] `npm run dev` starts the Vite dev server without errors.
- [x] `npm run build` produces a `dist/` bundle with no errors.
- [x] `react-scripts` is absent from `package.json`.

## Estimate
**Hours:** 2

## Notes
Removing `react-scripts` also broke `npm run lint`, since `.eslintrc.js`'s `@babel/eslint-parser` was resolving JSX support through `.babelrc` → `babel-preset-react-app` (a react-scripts transitive dependency). Fixed by deleting the stale `.babelrc` and pointing the parser at `@babel/preset-react` directly (added as a devDependency) — `npm run lint` is clean. Also removed the dead CRA `eslintConfig` block from `package.json` (superseded by `.eslintrc.js`, which ESLint already preferred) and fixed `README.md`'s `npm start` doc reference to `npm run dev`.
